rows.label: qst500103_msg0002
rows.name:
I have one question for an
experienced adventurer, mo.

rows.label: qst500103_msg0003
rows.name:
Do you think a Water Ladybird would
taste good in juice, mo?

rows.label: qst500103_msg0007
rows.name: So you think so too, mo!

rows.label: qst500103_msg0008
rows.name:
I have a feeling this could be
another huge hit after Twinklejuice,
mo!

rows.label: qst500103_msg0009
rows.name: You think it's a bad idea, mo?

rows.label: qst500103_msg0010
rows.name:
But you're not a juice professional,
so your opinion isn't much help, mo.

rows.label: qst500103_msg0011
rows.name:
Tanitani thinks adding a Water
Ladybird would make the juice a
perfect ten out of ten, mo!

rows.label: qst500103_msg0012
rows.name:
Now the Twelve Nopon Siblings in
Avaritia Trading Company are safe, mo!

rows.label: qst500103_msg0013
rows.name:
Some of my other siblings are also
looking for juice ingredients, mo.

rows.label: qst500103_msg0014
rows.name:
If you meet them, please be as kind
to them as you were to me, mo!
